name: Vector operis
wiring_note: NO SEAT, BECAUSE NO PART IN THE CATALOGUE CORRESPONDS TO IT. This creature came out of the images rather than out of a run: the passengers have been in every region 2 and region 3 frame, gripping ribbons, ranked along the long one's back, working across a mantle, and in region 3 they arrive in dozens on a structural animal, so they read as a population rather than an attachment. They are the most-drawn creature in the game and the only one with no entry. A seat is not withheld here for tidiness; there is nothing measured to seat.

fuel.law: IV. No fuel has ever been seated because this organism has never been run. Naming a plant here would be the invention the law exists to prevent.

receipt.claim: unwritten. The art shows a species that moves work along the routes between nodes; no experiment has ever measured such a thing
receipt.why_it_matters: it is listed so the roster's count is honest. The World 3 roster names eight creatures; read off the creature files themselves, five of the eight carry a non-null measured field, Sistens oneris is retracted, this one and Inaccessus sui are unmeasured. It is a candidate for a future run rather than a finding, and it does not enter the annex until something measures it.
